stem: A pump begins leaking near electrical connections while irrigation is running. What response best follows a hazard-control hierarchy?
choices: Stop exposure, isolate the affected equipment or energy source as authorized, control the leak, and correct the failure before restart
Continue the irrigation and place an absorbent pad under the leak
Tell workers to step over the wet area
Increase pump speed so the cycle finishes sooner
rationale: Immediate exposure control and correction of the source are stronger controls than relying on worker avoidance around interacting water and electrical hazards.
